letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or the gentle breezes of Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful life with you. I still remember the sparkle in your eyes on that magical February day, and each moment since has been a sweet adventure. You’re my cutie, my confidante, the rhythm to my heart’s song. No distance can dim the love that blooms brighter with each passing season, and I can’t wait to create countless more memories together.
poem:
In sunrise hues or desert night,  
Your laugh turns ordinary to bright.  
Across the dunes or city’s hum,  
My love for you forever hums.
